messages:
ara: Note for this week's train: slight cadence tweak + a new freeze-override policy. See bullets.

deploy-bot: Release cadence updated: weekly train pushed from Tue 18:00 UTC -> Wed 18:00 UTC for the next 3 cycles.

noah (release-manager): Freeze override policy: teams may request an override for low-risk, pre-approved ops (DNS TTLs, feature-flag flips) using `/freeze-override --svc <svc> --reason <short> --owner @you`. RM+SRE will respond within 30m.

sam (sre): During overrides we'll enforce a 10m smoke canary and extra synthetic probes for 1h. If any error or latency bump >10th percentile appears, we'll revert.

zoe (eng): Quick Q: are we allowed to use override for minor memory config bumps on the runtime?

noah (release-manager): Not unless the change has a pre-approved config key listed in the handbook. Add a short RFC if you think it should be whitelisted.

marta (product): Please include a 1-line blurb in the weekly digest: "Cadence shift to Wed for 3 weeks; freeze-override CLI for low-risk ops; 30m RM+SRE response SLA; 10m smoke canaries on override."

ci-bot: Audit token created: freeze-override-2026-03. Reference: https://redwood.internal/audit/freeze-override-2026-03

ara: Thanks all, acknowledge here if you see this. We'll lock changes in 24h unless there are major concerns.
file_description: announcement: release cadence shift and freeze-override policy with smoke canary requirements
